name: Cardamom bitters
description: Cardamom bitters are a complex aromatic infusion, born from the heart of the cardamom pod. These bitters boast a fragrance that is both warm and spicy, with a foundation of citrusy brightness and a lingering sweetness. Crafted through maceration—where crushed cardamom pods are steeped in a high-proof spirit with other botanicals—they release an intense and layered profile of flavors, offering a significant contribution to any drink they enhance. The resulting product is often used to add depth and intrigue to both classic and contemporary cocktails.
